name: WALL MOUNT WITH UNDERSINK
summary: A high-performance domestic RO water purifier designed for brackish water conditions. Equipped with advanced Reverse Osmosis technology, a Thin Film Composite membrane, multi-stage filtration, and energy-efficient operation, it delivers safe and purified drinking water with reliable performance.
features: Multi-stage filtration with Micron, GAC, and Post Carbon filters
Purification capacity of 12 litres per hour
Supports input TDS up to <3000 PPM
Compact wall mount design with under-sink installation option
Automatic pressure pump system with 24V DC operation
Includes faucet, pressure tank, and 5-meter tube

rows: 10" Micron Filter, 10" GAC, 10" Micron Filter, Post Carbon
